mapper.select: SELECT m.*, u.nickname AS user_name, u.username AS login_name, d.name AS dept_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ts.hours), 0) FROM pm_timesheet ts WHERE ts.project_id = m.project_id AND ts.user_id = m.user_id AND ts.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_hours FROM pm_member m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY CASE m.role WHEN 'MANAGER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.id

SELECT m.*, u.nickname AS user_name, u.username AS login_name, d.name AS dept_name, p.code AS project_code, p.name AS project_name, p.status AS project_status FROM pm_member m JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = m.project_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id WHERE p.status IN ('PLANNING', 'APPROVING', 'ACTIVE') AND u.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY u.id, p.code
